title: Hasan ke laal ka lasha bikhar gaya ran me
body:
wa qasima wawaila wa qasima wawaila
lahu ka maathe pe sehra nikhar gaya ran me
<<MINI>>
hasan ke laal ka laasha bikhar gaya ran me
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kubra nazro'n me rote hain tukde chunte huwe
kisi ko dekha nahi dard aise sehte huwe
hussain aate hai maidaan se ye kehte huwe
<<MINI>>
hasan ke laal ka laasha bikhar gaya ran me
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb dard ke manzar dikhayi dete hain
utha ke laasha-e-qasim hussain rote hai'n
tadap ke akber o abbas se ye kehte hain
<<MINI>>
hasan ke laal ka laasha bikhar gaya ran me
<<DIVIDER>>
makaa'n me shaadi ke matam ka shoor uthega
dulhan ke saamne aayega lasha dulha ka
ali ka laal jo sab se kahega kar ke buka
<<MINI>>
hasan ke laal ka laasha bikhar gaya ran me
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek gaam pe sarwar ke dil pe hai khanjar
ye nouha jaari hai ibne ali ke hoto'n par
mai apni beti se kaise kahunga ye jakar
<<MINI>>
hasan ke laal ka laasha bikhar gaya ran me
<<DIVIDER>>
nazar ke saamne lasha pada hai dilbar ka
khayaal agaya shabbir ko baradar ka
fida bayaan kare kaise dard sarwar ka
<<MINI>>
hasan ke laal ka laasha bikhar gaya ran me
